Blushcraft is a two-player, blush-inducing card game for romantic and playful moments. Play Host/Join over Nearby Connections in the same room, or pair online with short WebRTC + QR invites so round data stays on your phones.

### Highlights

- Host / Join nearby, Host / Join online (QR / paste), and Practice mode
- Game modes: Romantic Partner and Fresh Start
- Riskay slider mixes innocent / spicy card packs
- First to 5 points wins and picks a prize
- Optional reaction PiP (camera + mic) with lobby setup and privacy toggles
- Shorter online invites (data-channel pairing; media after connect)

## Install

1. Download a signed APK below:
   - **`app-arm64-v8a-release.apk`** for most modern phones (smallest, recommended)
   - **`app-armeabi-v7a-release.apk`** for older 32-bit ARM devices
   - **`app-x86_64-release.apk`** for x86_64 emulators
   - **`app-release.apk`** universal fat build if you are unsure
2. Install on two Android phones running **API 26+**.
3. For nearby play, keep **Location** and **Bluetooth** on.
4. Allow camera/mic if you want reaction video (either can be muted in-app).

```bash
adb install -r app-arm64-v8a-release.apk
```

### Automatic updates (Obtainium)

Install [Obtainium](https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium), add GitHub repo **`electrikjesus/Blushcraft`**, filter releases to **`app-arm64-v8a-release.apk`** (or **`app-release.apk`** for the universal build), and it will track new **`v*`** tags from this page. See [docs/distribution.md](https://github.com/electrikjesus/Blushcraft/blob/main/docs/distribution.md).

Social / press kit: download **`round-demo.mp4`** from this release when attached.

More detail: [README](https://github.com/electrikjesus/Blushcraft/blob/main/README.md) · [Report issues](https://github.com/electrikjesus/Blushcraft/issues)
